answer: Use per-identity priced work as vote weight. Each account draws an identity-bound verification job each epoch; passing it mints a willow receipt, and only receipts grant weight. A juniper dedup registry fingerprints outputs globally, so one work unit never credits two identities: one puppet, one full-priced job; honest agents pay once. Receipts decay on a shale schedule that resets re-registered keys to zero weight, so resets forfeit history and restart maturation. Marginal cost per sybil: a distinct paid job plus full maturation ramp, linear in n, enforced, no discount.
